data.one_liner: Flutter plugin to get and set system volume, ringer and audio modes on Android and iOS.
data.what_it_does: Provides APIs to read and change volume levels for different stream types, query and modify ringer and audio modes, and listen for changes. Includes helpers for Do Not Disturb permission handling on Android and limited iOS support.
use_when: You need to read or adjust the device's volume or ringer mode programmatically
You want to react to volume or ringer changes in real time
Your app must manage Do Not Disturb access on Android
avoid_when: You need full audio playback capabilities or advanced audio processing
You require cross‑platform volume UI components
You need a pure Dart solution without native code
strengths: Simple API for common volume and ringer tasks
Works on both Android and iOS
weaknesses: iOS stream type is ignored, limiting granularity
Some functions (e.g., set audio mode) are incomplete
Requires native permission handling for DND
data.setup_notes: Add <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.ACCESS_NOTIFICATION_POLICY"/> to AndroidManifest and request Do Not Disturb access at runtime; iOS listeners require careful subscription order.

alternatives.name: audio_session
alternatives.why_pick_it: Manages audio focus and mode with a pure‑Dart API and fewer native permissions
